These alc.ca Terms of Service ("Terms of Service") govern all aspects of Your use of alc.ca, which includes promotions.alc.ca as well as applications linked to these websites and made available on mobile devices, including any transactions You may complete or attempt to complete using alc.ca. PLEASE READ THESE TERMS OF SERVICE CAREFULLY. By using the alc.ca site, You acknowledge Your full understanding and acceptance of the terms and conditions contained within these Terms of Service, (as amended from time to time), and confirm that: (a) You are at least 19 years of age; (b) You are a resident of either Newfoundland and Labrador, Nova Scotia, New Brunswick or Prince Edward Island (collectively, “Atlantic Canada”); and (c) You will not purchase any alc.ca Games while You are physically located outside Atlantic Canada. If You do not accept any of the terms and conditions in these Terms of Service or You do not agree to be legally bound by them, do not use alc.ca.
1.1 Definitions
See Schedule “A” for meanings of certain words and terms used in these Terms of Service.
1.2 Introduction

Atlantic Lottery Corporation Inc. (“ALC”, “our”, “we” and “us”) offers to residents of Atlantic Canada, who are 19 years of age or older, the opportunity to register online with ALC and, if approved and granted an Account at ALC’s sole and absolute discretion, to play Games offered on alc.ca. ALC has the right at any time and in its sole and absolute discretion to, without notice, discontinue or limit the sale of Games through alc.ca or to modify the manner in which it sells Games.
1.3 Game Rules
All Games offered on alc.ca are governed by and offered subject to the Game Rules that apply to each particular Game.

ALC’s alc.ca Healthy Play and Break in Play Policy (“Healthy Play Policy”) describes the Healthy Play (“HP”) program, interactions with Players, and the tools and resources that are available both to Players, and, as well, to members of the public in Atlantic Canada should they decide to register as a Player on alc.ca.

ALC’s Healthy Play Policy forms part of these Terms of Service. By accepting these Terms of Service, You also acknowledge and accept the terms of this Healthy Play Policy. Be sure to read and understand the Healthy Play Policy before agreeing to these Terms of Service.

3.1 Requirement to Register/Eligibility Only Players are allowed to play Games on alc.ca and qualify for Prizes. In order to be eligible to be registered as a Player, You must be at least 19 years of age, a resident of Atlantic Canada, physically located within Atlantic Canada at time of registration and not already a Player and not an Individual on a Break in Play.
If You fail to successfully complete the registration/verification process required to obtain an Account and become a Player, You will be assigned an Unverified Account.

3.2 Verification of Registration Information You are solely responsible for the truthfulness, accuracy and correctness of the information that You provide to ALC in connection with Your registration to become a Player. You are responsible for updating this information in Your "My Account" if the information changes after Your registration for an Account has been accepted by ALC. You are solely responsible to ensure that You remain entitled to have an Account under the terms of these Terms of Service. Failure to update such details so that they remain true, accurate and correct at all times that You are using alc.ca may, in ALC's sole and absolute discretion, result in the suspension or termination of Your Account and the nullification, voiding or forfeiture of any Prizes to which You might otherwise be entitled.

ALC may, in its sole and absolute discretion, require You to provide additional information and/or documentation (for example, proof of age and province of residence; Your bank or other financial institution and related account information) to verify or confirm Your eligibility to be registered as a Player, to verify or confirm that You continue to meet eligibility requirements to be a Player and to investigate any suspected breaches of these Terms of Service (including suspected fraudulent or dishonest activity).

You agree that ALC may contact or retain third parties (including Your financial institution) to verify the accuracy of any information (including personal information related to Your age and province of residence and Your bank or other financial institution and related account information) that You provide in connection with Your registration to become a Player (including any updates to such information).

You may be required to provide additional information and/or documentation to comply with applicable laws or regulations. If you register to play Casino Games on alc.ca, You will be required to provide ALC such information and documentation as ALC may determine that it requires in order to comply with its FINTRAC reporting obligations. By providing such additional information or documentation to ALC, the Player will be deemed to represent and warrant to ALC that such information is true and accurate or that such documentation is a true, accurate and complete copy of the original.
3.3 Only One Account is Permitted You are not permitted to have more than one Account. Only You the Player, acting on Your own behalf, is permitted to use the Account.

3.4 Passwords/Email When You register with alc.ca, You will be required to use an email account and choose a unique password. It is Your responsibility to keep Your password confidential and secure. Only You are permitted to access and use alc.ca using Your password. You will be solely responsible for any use or misuse of Your password by any person. ALC is not liable for any access to or use of Your Account, including arising from unauthorized use of Your password. You agree that ALC shall be entitled to assume that any user of alc.ca who enters the correct combination of Your email and password is You and that any transaction involving Your Account has been undertaken by You and is valid.
3.5 Deactivation of Account
a) By Player You may deactivate Your Account at any time by contacting ALC’s Customer Care Center.

b) By ALC ALC may deactivate Your Account if it is an Inactive Account. An Account is an Inactive Account if, during the immediately preceding twenty-four (24) months, You have not successfully signed into alc.ca.

In the event that Your Account is deactivated under a) or b), You must provide ALC with such information and documentation as ALC determines necessary to enable ALC to deliver any funds remaining in the Account (except any balance from Promo Cash) to You. ALC will deliver such balances by direct deposit or by other means selected by ALC in its sole discretion. In the event that You do not provide ALC with such information within eight (8) weeks of Your Account being deactivated, You agree that You shall forfeit all right to the remaining funds.
4.1 No Interference with Games You will not interfere or manipulate with the operations of alc.ca or the normal play of any Game, nor will You attempt to do so, directly or indirectly.

4.2 No Unlawful/Fraudulent Use You will not use alc.ca in an unlawful manner, or for any unlawful or fraudulent purpose or activity or to gain an unfair advantage including, without limitation, cheating, game manipulation, exploiting a fault, loophole or error, fraud, including payment fraud (for example, unlawful use of credit cards or reversals of payment), money laundering, collusion with third parties, using any automated device or software that makes decisions for You or takes Your place as a live Player, or for any other purpose or activity that ALC, in its sole and absolute discretion, determines is inappropriate or not directly related to the purchase or playing of Games or the use of Chat in the normal course as determined by ALC. You acknowledge and agree that other Players may use or attempt to use alc.ca in such a prohibited manner and that You are using alc.ca at Your own risk and ALC will not be liable for any losses or damage caused to You by such prohibited use of alc.ca.

4.3 No Play Outside of Atlantic Canada You shall not purchase or attempt to purchase any Game while You are physically located outside Atlantic Canada or if You are no longer a resident of Atlantic Canada.

5.1 Account Funding You must have sufficient funds in Your Account (Wallet) in order to complete a purchase of or play Games. Notwithstanding the foregoing, You may purchase tickets for certain Draw Based Games using Direct Pay. When using Direct Pay to complete a purchase of a Draw Based Game, You are solely responsible for ensuring that your payment card is valid, operational and authorized by the issuing financial institution to process such transactions.
You can add funds to Your Account (Wallet) by means of:
1. WebCash or Promo Cash;

2. Electronic bank transfer (EBT) initiated through a Canadian bank or financial institution. Your Internet or telephone banking service must be linked to a bank account at a branch of a bank or financial institution located in Atlantic Canada;
3. Visa or MasterCard credit card issued in Canada by a Canadian bank or financial institution. (Note: may be treated by card issuer as a cash advance);
4. An Interac e-Transfer Deposit initiated by you, from your bank or financial institution located in Canada;
5. A Visa Debit card issued in Canada by a Canadian bank or financial institution;
6. PayPal, which is a digital wallet (online account) that will allow you to send payments to alc.ca.
7. American Express (Amex) Credit Card

8. Scan to Deposit for the transfer of Prizes up to $999.99 to your wallet. Scan to Deposit is exclusively for the transfer of Prizes that have a dollar value and cannot be used for Free Play or other Prizes that do not have a dollar value.
9. Apple Pay is a digital payment wallet that provide an easy and secure way to pay for your alc.ca purchases.
10. Google Pay is a digital payment wallet offered by Google LLC that is an easy secure way to pay your alc.ca purchases.

You are responsible for all fees and charges arising from Your use of the cards and services used to fund Your Account referred to in items 2-10 above. Certain methods of payment listed above may not be available to You at all times. You should familiarize yourself with the terms and conditions that govern Your use of the cards and services referred to above prior to funding Your Account. Each time You use a credit card, Visa Debit Card, Interac e-Transfer, PayPal, American Express, Apple Pay, Google Pay or EBT to fund Your Account, You represent and warrant to ALC that You have the authority to use that card or the funds for such purpose, including if the card or bank account is jointly held with one or more persons.

5.2 Limits on Accounts From time to time ALC may, in its sole and absolute discretion, but will not be obligated to, determine and set limits on the minimum and maximum amounts that You will be permitted to deposit into Your Account, can have on deposit in Your Account or can withdraw from Your Account, or Your ability to engage in Direct Pay.
5.3 Maximum Weekly Deposit Limit Pursuant to ALC’s Healthy Play Policy prior to depositing funds to Your Account or using Direct Pay, You will be required to establish a Maximum Weekly Deposit Limit.

5.4 Daily Wager Limit Pursuant to ALC’s Healthy Play Policy You can set a Maximum Daily Wager Limit, in Your sole discretion. You will not be able to wager any amount on alc.ca beyond the Daily Wager Limit You have established.

5.5 Session Time Limits Pursuant to ALC’s Healthy Play Policy. You may set a limit on the total time You spend per session playing on alc.ca. You will be notified via a pop-up reminder five (5) minutes before your allotted session time limit. A subsequent pop-up message will be displayed to You one (1) minute before reaching Your time limit. Further details are setout in the Healthy Play Policy.
5.6 Currency All transactions involving Your Account will be in Canadian dollars only.

5.7 Account Withdrawals Funds on deposit in Your Account cannot be transferred to another Player or Account. Except as otherwise provided in these Terms of Service, funds on deposit in Your Account may be withdrawn by You at any time by electronic funds transfer to an account maintained with Your bank or other financial institution. You may not withdraw funds from Your Account to a credit card, debit card or via cheque. You are solely responsible for the accuracy of bank account information that is provided to ALC. ALC will not be responsible for lost, misdirected or misplaced funds as a result of You providing incorrect or out-of-date bank account information.

Payments in respect of a withdrawal may be delayed by or as a result of ALC's internal processing times and security reviews or ALC's compliance with the requirements of applicable laws. For example, ALC may require information and documentation from You that it considers necessary or advisable in its sole discretion, including without limitation information and documentation ALC determines necessary or advisable to:
a. verify Your identity;
b. comply with applicable law or regulatory requirements including FINTRAC reporting obligations;
c. comply with ALC's validation and security procedures;
d. to prevent fraud or other illegal activity (whether suspected or actual); and
e. to ensure compliance with these terms and conditions, Game Rules and Legal Terms of Use.

Except as otherwise provided in these Terms of Service, funds on deposit in Your Account will be withdrawn from Your Account and returned to Your bank account provided by You at the time of registration (or any updated bank account), or by other means selected by ALC in its sole discretion by ALC if:
· You submit a proper request;
· Your registration with alc.ca is deactivated by You or ALC or suspended by ALC for longer than 30 days;

· You exercise the Break in Play option under and in accordance with ALC’s Healthy Play Policy for a period of six (6) months or longer; Note: You can request a refund if Your Break in Play is less than six (6) months; or
· the amount of funds on deposit in Your Account exceeds the limit established by ALC from time to time.

We may submit reports to applicable governmental or quasi-governmental authorities or other persons or entities specified under applicable laws, including FINTRAC reporting, and withhold any amount from the aggregate amount of Your withdrawal in order to comply with applicable laws (and Your acceptance of and agreement to be bound by these Terms of Service represents Your consent to the collection and disclosure of Your personal information by ALC if required in connection with such reporting requirements). ALC will also comply with applicable laws in Atlantic Canada relating to the collection and enforcement of court orders or agreements that have been registered with the court with respect to the payment of child and spousal support including the Maintenance Enforcement Act (Nova Scotia) and the Support Orders Enforcement Act (Newfoundland and Labrador).

5.8 Chargebacks A Chargeback occurs for the purpose of these Terms of Service, when a credit or debit card holder contacts the bank or other financial institution that issued the card, to initiate a refund for a payment transaction that was made using the card or the account associated with the card, and the bank or financial institution requests that ALC return the relevant funds.
In the event of a Chargeback, ALC may in its sole and absolute discretion, carry out one or more of the following actions:
a) suspend Your Account pending resolution of any dispute relating to the Chargeback (in which case Subscriptions may be suspended);

b) request information from You regarding the circumstances of the Chargeback and provide such information to the relevant financial institution for the purposes of resolving any dispute relating to the Chargeback;
c) debit Your Account any corresponding AL Rewards points associated with the Chargeback;
d) debit Your Account with the amount of the Chargeback and if that debit results in a negative balance, claim from You the amount of such negative balance; and
e) terminate Your Account.

5.9 Errors in Accounts You acknowledge and agree that You are solely responsible for reviewing Your Account for accuracy and completeness from time to time. You are required to inform ALC as soon as You become aware of any error or omission with respect to Your Account or any calculation with respect to any purchase that You have made or any wager that You have placed from Your Account.

5.10 Payment Processors ALC may use third-party electronic payment processors and bank or other financial institutions to process financial transactions to and from Your Account. By registering with alc.ca and establishing an Account, You irrevocably authorize ALC to instruct these entities to handle deposits into and withdrawals from Your Account and You irrevocably agree that ALC may provide such instructions on Your behalf in accordance with Your requests as submitted using the relevant feature on alc.ca.

5.11 Promo Cash From time to time ALC may, in its sole and absolute discretion, but will not be obligated to, offer Promo Cash offers which, when accepted by You, will be deposited by ALC into Your Account. Promo Cash may only be used in relation to such Games on alc.ca as may be specified by ALC from time to time, and does not have a cash-equivalent value that can be withdrawn from Your Account. The use of Promo Cash may be subject to additional terms, conditions and restrictions specified by ALC from time to time.

ALC reserves the right to cancel, withdraw or amend any Promo Cash offers (including the applicable terms and conditions) at any time. Any Player whose account has been suspended, is otherwise not in good standing, or if the Player chooses the Break in Play option under ALC’s Healthy Play Policy will not be eligible to redeem any Promo Cash during any such period. If your Account is deactivated or terminated, all Promo Cash which has not been wagered by You and which remains in Your Account at the time when Your Account is so deactivated or terminated, will be forfeited and will not be paid to You.

6.1 Accuracy of Purchase and Play Decision You are solely responsible for ensuring that the details of Your purchase and/or play decisions are correct before You submit Your purchase and/or play decisions for processing. In the event of any dispute or discrepancy regarding any aspect of Your purchase and/or play decisions, THE INFORMATION IN THE COMPUTER SYSTEMS WILL PREVAIL, AND ONLY THE PURCHASE AND/OR PLAY DECISION RECORDED BY THE COMPUTER SYSTEMS WILL PARTICIPATE IN THE GAME. Without limiting the generality of the above provisions of section 6.1, this means that, in the event of a dispute or discrepancy, information in the Computer Systems will prevail over information on any website operated by ALC or any application linked to any website operated by ALC and made available on a mobile device (i.e. will prevail over items (i) and (ii) within the definition of alc.ca in these Terms of Service).

6.2 Notification and Receipts – Draw Based Games If Your purchase of a Draw Based Game is fully processed by ALC prior to the cut-off time established by ALC, which said processing includes, without limitation, the complete transfer from Your Account of the full amount required to pay for the purchase, ALC will issue a Receipt which will show, among other things, the selection(s) and the date(s) of the draw(s) or event(s) for which the selection(s) are valid, the amount wagered and a receipt ID number. All valid Receipts are deemed to be tickets under the applicable Game Rules that govern the particular Game. Receipts will appear in Your Account History.

The Receipt confirms that the purchase has been completed. Your order and any details or confirmation of Your order, as reflected in Your Cart or otherwise, is not a ticket, has no monetary value and does not entitle You to participate in any Game. You can modify or cancel Your order prior to issuance of a Receipt only.
6.3 No Cancellation of Purchase Once You have made a purchase, You may not cancel it.

6.4 Direct Pay – If You choose to pay for a Draw Based Game using Direct Pay, You must pay the total purchase value using Direct Pay and You are not permitted to use any other method of payment to pay for any portion of the total purchase value, including WebCash, Promo Cash, AL Rewards points and/or any funds in Your Account (Wallet).

6.5 Direct Pay Methods A list of all currently accepted Direct Pay Methods can be found on the Direct Pay page on alc.ca and no other payment methods are permitted when using Direct Pay. ALC reserves the right to change, add or remove accepted Direct Pay Methods, and the terms and conditions applicable to accepted Direct Pay Methods. Players are solely responsible for reviewing accepted Direct Pay Methods before initiating any transaction with ALC.
6.6 Right to Refuse ALC reserves the right to, in its sole and absolute discretion, refuse any Game purchase, play decision or selection for any reason whatsoever.
6.7 Cut-Off Times Purchases and/or play decisions will not be accepted or processed after the posted cut-off time.
6.8 Interrupted Games – Instant Games and Casino Games

ALC reserves the right to complete any Instant Game(s) that You fail to play to completion within seven (7) days from the date of Your purchase of the Instant Game, and to award any resulting Prize to You in accordance with the terms and conditions of these Terms of Service.

ALC reserves the right to terminate/close any Casino Game(s) that You fail to play to completion within thirty (30) days from the date of Your purchase of the Casino Game, in which case, ALC will issue a reimbursement payment of the original wager amount for that incomplete Game(s). Subject to ALC’s discretion, You forfeit any winnings accumulated during the play of the Casino Game that you failed to complete as well as any potential winnings that could have occurred had you completed the Casino Game(s). If you are disconnected from a Live Casino Round, any placed bets remain valid and are settled in your absence.

If You intentionally interfere with the playing of an Instant or Casino Game as determined by ALC in its discretion, You will forfeit: Your wager/purchase price, Your ability to continue playing or completing the Game and any winnings accumulated during the play of the Game as well as any potential winnings and any AL Rewards points earned in connection with such Games.
6.9 Final Results In all circumstances, ALC's records will be the final authority in determining the results of any Game that is offered by ALC through alc.ca.
6.10 Game Availability It is possible that certain Game titles listed on alc.ca will not be available for purchase in your Province of residency.

6.11 Progressive Jackpot If ALC discontinues any Game with a Progressive Jackpot for any reason, any remaining prize pool amounts contributed to by Players will be redistributed to other ALC Game(s) with a Progressive Jackpot, in ALC’s sole and absolute discretion.
In addition to the terms and conditions in these Terms of Service, the following terms and conditions apply to Subscriptions:

7.1 Players can purchase Subscriptions for certain Draw Based Games made available for Subscription purchase by ALC from time to time. 7.5 Cancellation, alteration or modification of Subscription and Subscription Receipts ALC reserves the right to cancel, alter or modify, at any time, the whole or part of the Draw Based Game subscribed for, and/or any Subscription or Subscription Receipt or any condition attaching to Subscriptions or Subscription Receipts. If a Draw Based Game, a Subscription or a Subscription Receipt is cancelled, ALC will make a proportionate refund to Players affected. The new Subscription Receipt shall be effective from the date on which the alteration or modification was entered into the Computer Systems.

7.6 Rules, Regulations and Conditions Subscriptions, Subscription Receipts (as altered or modified), as well as the Draw Based Games that Players can purchase and/or participate in using Subscriptions, are all governed by Game Rules and these Terms of Service.

7.7 IMPORTANT If there is a discrepancy between the numbers shown on a Subscription or on a Subscription Receipt and those contained in the Computer Systems, only the numbers recorded in the Computer Systems participate in the draws on the draw days recorded in the Computer Systems and the Subscription or Subscription Receipt will be deemed to be amended to reflect the actual numbers so recorded. ALC has no liability relating to the numbers appearing on the Subscription or the Subscription Receipt in such circumstances.

7.8 Conditions of Payment Where ALC accepts payment for a Subscription that is subsequently dishonored, refused or reversed, (including Chargebacks), in addition to other rights or remedies contained in Game Rules or these Terms of Service, ALC may terminate the Subscription as to future draws and shall be entitled to recover from the Player in contract an amount equal to the wagers on draws in which the subscriber did participate under the Subscription prior to such termination.

7.10 Break in Play If a Player who has purchased a Subscription within a four (4) week automatic renewal option(s) subsequently elects to take any Break in Play, the automatic renewal feature will terminate and no further purchases will be processed under that Subscription, however Subscriptions purchased before a Break in Play remain valid.

8.1 Entitlement to Prizes You acknowledge and agree that if You are entitled to any Prize resulting from the purchase or playing of any Game on alc.ca, Your ability to claim and receive the Prize will be subject to these Terms of Service, the Game Rules, applicable laws (including FINTRAC for Casino Games and any regulations made thereunder) and ALC’s Prize payment rules, requirements, processes and restrictions.

8.2 Prizes Prizes up to $24,999.99 from Games that are purchased or played on alc.ca will automatically be deposited into Your Account. Upon deposit of the Prize to Your Account, You release and discharge ALC, its employees, officers, directors and shareholders from any further claims, actions or demands in respect of that Prize.

Prizes of "free plays" for Draw Based Games on alc.ca (including for Subscriptions) will be processed by ALC automatically, and You acknowledge and agree that ALC may not process such a "free play" Prize prior to the cut-off time for any particular draw. In ALC's sole and absolute discretion, an amount equal to the cash-equivalent of a free play prize may be deposited in Your Account. You are responsible for reviewing Your Account to determine whether any Prize or other winnings has been awarded to You. Note: AL Rewards points are not issued on free plays.

10.1 Introduction

10.1.1 The AL Rewards Program (the “Program”) is a rewards program offered by ALC and subject to these Terms of Service. The Program allows eligible persons to enroll as Members to accumulate AL Rewards points through the purchase of eligible ALC products and to redeem AL Rewards points for Promo Cash. From time to time, Members may also have access to certain contests for participating in Healthy Play activities, subject to the Healthy Play Contest Rules. These Terms of Service apply to and govern Your participation in the Program, Your entitlement to collect and use AL Rewards points and any other benefits of the Program.

10.1.2 Read these Terms of Service in full before registering for an alc.ca account or becoming an AL Rewards Member. Your registration and participation in any aspect of the Program constitute Your full agreement and acceptance of these Terms of Service.
10.2 Eligibility

10.2.1 Membership in the Program is free and You do not need to purchase anything to become an AL Rewards Member. To participate, You must be a resident of Atlantic Canada and be 19 years of age or older at the time of enrollment.
10.3 Earning AL Rewards Points

10.3.1 To earn AL Rewards points, You must scan Your eligible winning and non-winning retail tickets on the ALC mobile app or mobile web view. Alternatively, You can enter a retail ticket manually on a desktop computer. Qualifying alc.ca purchases automatically earn points for Program members, and no extra step is required. AL Rewards points are earned and capped on certain products at the rates and under the additional conditions set out on alc.ca/Rewards, the ALC mobile app, or in the terms and conditions of any other offer we may make available from time to time (the “Eligible Products”).
10.3.2 There are several ways to earn AL Rewards points, as outlined below:

a. Standard Points: AL Rewards points are earned on certain products at the rates and additional conditions set out from time to time on alc.ca/Rewards, ALC mobile app, or in the terms and conditions of any offer.

b. Promotional Points: Occasionally, AL Rewards points may be awarded to Members for the purchase of certain products or on achieving predetermined purchase amounts during a certain promotional time period.
Participating products and games can be found on alc.ca here:

10.3.3 AL Rewards points for online purchases will be posted to Your Account within 72 hours following an eligible transaction. AL Rewards points for Draw-Based Games purchased online will be posted to Your Account the day after the applicable draw.

10.3.4 Pro Line tickets purchased at retail are only eligible for AL Rewards points once the last Pro Line event on the ticket has started. AL Rewards points will be posted to your account after being entered or scanned. Pro Line tickets purchased online are only eligible for AL Rewards points once all events on the ticket are settled. In the event a Pro Line event is cancelled, Pro Line tickets purchased at both retail and online will be eligible for AL Rewards points.
10.3.5 Draw Based Games purchased at retail are only eligible for AL Rewards points once the applicable draw has been completed.

10.3.6 In line with our commitment to promote healthy play habits, the following table delineating the total daily points cap, as well as daily points caps on points earned by game category, will apply to the Program:
Total Daily Points Cap 15,000
All Roulette Games 10,000
All Baccarat Games 10,000
Sports Category 10,000

Ex. If a Member earns 10,000 AL Rewards points from playing Roulette, then plays Baccarat and earns 7,500 AL Rewards points (for a total of 17,500 points earned for that day), the Member will only be eligible to earn a maximum of 15,000 AL Rewards points total for all play on that day. For the purposes of calculating the total daily points cap, each day begins at 3:00:00 a.m. Atlantic Time and ends at 2:59:59 a.m. Atlantic Time.
10.3.7 Retail tickets entered into Your Account to earn AL Rewards points will be applied to the total daily points cap on the day they are entered.
10.3.8 Any AL Rewards points accumulated which exceed the daily points cap will be forfeited.
10.4 Redeeming AL Rewards

10.4.1 AL Rewards points may be exchanged for Promo Cash only. Once a Member exchanges their AL Rewards points for Promo Cash, no changes, cancellations, exchanges, or refunds are permitted. You must have sufficient AL Rewards points in your Account to redeem Promo Cash (1,000 points = $1). AL Rewards points have no monetary value whatsoever and cannot under any circumstances form the basis of a monetary claim against ALC, our shareholders, or any other third party that may from time to time participate in the Program, including our partners and suppliers, and cannot be converted to cash.
10.5 Registration

10.5.1 To register for the Program, You must create or have a verified Account.
